title: Canonical localization normalizations of etale scalar comparisons
statement: Use the etale ringed presentation, literal native restriction and ordinary native comparisons [def-pur-etale-ringed-projection-presentation], with GeometricData, ExactData and OrdinaryIdentification [def-sfb-constant-module-geometric-comparison-data]. Define NativeLeftNormalization as the commuting square, on every cochain complex, between localization of ordinaryNativeLeft and the exact-termwise/native-left-derived comparison. Define NativeRightNormalization as the commuting square between ordinaryNativeRight and the universal right-derived units, on every cochain complex; on K-injectives it computes the right-derived comparison. Define RingedPullbackTensorData as ordinary and derived strong monoidal structures on the scalar-extension inverse image with ordinary oplax tensorator equal to its recorded pure-tensor comparison and derived tensorator satisfying TensorNormalization [def-sfb-derived-projection-comparison-squares]. These are predicates and data types, asserting no existence and imposing no bound on complexes.
